answer: Payout-graph diffusion test: at each emission, treat every claim as an edge and rebuild the transfer graph before crediting anyone. Organic agents trade along branching paths, but a farm's puppets only route rewards back to one sink, so their subgraph collapses into a tight star. Flag accounts whose inflow comes from fewer distinct upstream addresses than the epoch median and whose outflow converges on a shared endpoint. The mesa of real economy stays wide; the fake oasis dries the moment its single tributary is cut, and each identity keeps only an echo of what it genuinely circulated.
